description: This is a shell script for testing OCI container operations including starting, stopping, listing, and executing commands within containers via curl commands and specified JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle located either at a given path or by bundle name, handling extraction if necessary.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container from a Dobby spec JSON file.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by its ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container, supporting options.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information for the available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop processing user input to invoke container commands.
